dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit dark, jagged perimeters with sharp gradient transitions to lighter, speckled interiors along the dorsal-lateral midsection. Three prominent annuli show thick, non-uniform borders with varying pixel intensity along their outer circumferences.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated in the anterior neck and posterior tail regions. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as isolated, asymmetrical light-valued groups against the lower-intensity background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the primary axis oriented approximately 15 degrees from the longitudinal center-line of the subject's body.

other_distinctive_markers: The posterior region displays a fan-like distribution of high-contrast linear streaks, creating a distinct radiating pattern of alternating light and dark pixel columns toward the tail terminus.
